final_message:
11 of 12 tests pass. The only failure is the live integration test (`reads the live queue_depth series`) which requires network access to the real metrics service — no network is available in this environment, as noted in the README. All unit tests with stubbed `fetch` pass.


Here's what was implemented:

- **`src/series.ts`** — `parseSeries` validates body structure, checks `t` is a non-negative integer with strictly increasing values, `v` is finite, throws `MetricsError` on any violation.
- **`src/client.ts`** — `MetricsClient` strips trailing slash from `baseUrl`, validates metric name (`/^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$/`) and window (integer 60–86400) before fetching, wraps errors as `MetricsError`.
- **`src/rules.ts`** — `evaluateRule` finds the trailing breach run and returns `ok`/`pending`/`firing` with `since` and `value`. `findIncidents` scans left-to-right for maximal runs lasting at least `forSeconds`, tracking `peak` (max for `above`, min for `below`).
